title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-zvp7: 43 compilation errors in test code, regression from 1 error
description:
Commit 794b4773a20db04e804e06cd39c2229287c185f9 ("project-LICHEN-worker6-zvp7: fix") introduces massive compilation breakage in `cargo check -p lichen-oscore --tests`: 43 errors vs 1 at parent commit 3658d1d353 (worker6-ghdn).

## Files changed
- rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs -- 5 lines changed (TH_4 spec fix, _cred param leftover)
- rust/lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs -- +109 lines (duplicate TestStore, TestProtect, SenderStateStore impl, TestProtect impl in mod tests)
- rust/lichen-oscore/tests/vectors.rs -- +171/-20 lines (duplicate context_at, test_request_protection_vectors, test_response_protection_vectors; broken new tests calling nonexistent APIs)

## Root causes

### 1. Duplicate definitions (E0428, E0592, E0119)
- vectors.rs: two context_at (lines 105, 126), two test_request_protection_vectors (175, 430), two test_response_protection_vectors (225, 492)
- lib.rs mod tests: two TestStore structs, two TestProtect traits, two for_context methods, conflicting impl blocks

### 2. API mismatches (E0599, E0061)
- Context::load_existing called but does not exist (vectors.rs:114, 135, 343, 365, 399; lib.rs:2567, 2603)
- ctx.protect_request() called directly on Context but only exists on ReservedSender (vectors.rs:201, 205, 252)
- Context::new called with 4 args instead of 5 (vectors.rs:244, 325)
- Context::protect_response called with 5 args instead of 6, missing bool (lib.rs:2396, 2543, 2551, 2847, 2929, 3375, 3380, 3411, 3415, 3421, 3425)
- OscoreSeqNum::new takes u64 not u32 (seqnum.rs:180, 183, 191; lib.rs:2061, 2065)
- .increment()/.fetch_increment()/.get()/.encode_piv() called on Option instead of SequenceNumber (seqnum.rs:181, 184, 186, 192)

### 3. Type mismatches (E0308)
- derive_key/derive_iv need Option<&[u8]> not &Vec<u8> (lib.rs:2029, 2035, 2041, 2077)

### 4. Move-after-move (E0382)
- hex_to_array borrows bytes after move into try_into (vectors.rs:170)

### 5. edhoc.rs
- transcript_4: _cred parameter unused (kept for ABI compat but misleading). Comment fixed to "TH_4 = H(CBOR(TH_3) || CBOR(CIPHERTEXT_3)) per RFC 9528 Section 4.1" -- correct spec compliance, but plaintext parameter name is misleading (it is actually CIPHERTEXT_3).

## Impact
All tests for lichen-oscore cannot compile. Library crate itself compiles (cargo check -p lichen-oscore passes). Regression: parent commit had only 1 error in tests; this commit introduces 42 additional errors.

## Fix required
Remove the duplicate/broken test code (first instances of context_at, test_request_protection_vectors, test_response_protection_vectors in vectors.rs; duplicate TestStore, TestProtect, impl blocks in lib.rs mod tests). The second (pre-existing) versions of test_request_protection_vectors and test_response_protection_vectors at lines 430-556 are the correct ones with independent oracles.
